description: This file contains functions to manage firmware upgrades on a Linksys device running OpenWrt. It determines the current firmware partition and switches boot partitions accordingly, as well as handling the upgrade process based on firmware image magic numbers.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the active firmware partition (kernel1 or kernel2) based on current environment variables and UBI partition info, and sets the environment for the alternate partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Handles the firmware upgrade process by identifying the target partition, verifying the firmware image magic number, and executing the appropriate upgrade steps.
